steps.content: Your radiating presence burns the intruder's skin, forcing them into a lower stance as every cell in their body screams danger.
Tension coils through the room like steel wire, pulled so taut that the slightest tremor is impossible.
Then, you see the intruder slowly lean forward, preparing to set down the painting.
Giving up already?
No, no way. They must be—
SWISH!!!
An unexpected blast rips the silence to shreds.

The windows along the wall don't merely break; they vaporize into a storm of lethal glitter, blasted inward with terrifying force. Your attention is instantly caught by the sheer violence of their destruction.
What follows is a violation of motion, a teleport across the room. Physics abandons the figure streaking toward the window.
The intruder lands on the window frame with perfect precision, and for a brief moment, a barely perceptible expression of shock betrays them.
As that shock transmutes into pure focus, every movement around them seems to solidify, frozen in place.
The intruder gains the rooftop, their labored breathing paced like a steady, forging beat. Their focus never wavers, already shifting to the next point in their path.
Their eyes in this instant are pure, honed intent. A cold, mechanical focus where no warmth survives.
Before the panorama of night-drenched streets, the intruder steps back into open air, a leap of effortless poise.
Hundreds of meters in the void, that dark shape sails as if on unseen wings, consumed by the greater dark.
Then, the night is torn by the sound of engines. Headlights stab once through the blackness before being swallowed by the woods.
After them!!
At your command, the guards exit the gallery at once, charging in the direction the intruder disappeared.
You start to follow, but a faint sound from inside the gallery stops you cold.
There, on the exhibition platform the intruder used, a small and sinister rift is quietly forming. It spews a continuous stream of contaminants, all laced with the power of Mania.
A dimensional rift...? Could this be connected to the recent incidents?!
But thought is a luxury at the moment. You must destroy it before the rift's spawn spreads further.

After swiftly dealing with the rift, you burst outside. The advance team is already converging on the motorcycle, leaving only the small arrest squad you brought from the Bureau, standing at the ready and awaiting your command.
You hold the order. Instead, you narrow your eyes at the shattered window.
The paintings are displayed on the gallery's second floor. It's not a deadly drop, but no ordinary person—no matter how athletic—could descend from that height and leave not a single trace behind.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Unless...

Crimson light gathers in your palm, then pulses outward in a silent wave, washing over the scene. And there, etched in the aftermath of the energy, you see them. Several faint, lingering trails of a familiar power, tracing from the windowsill down to the ground, then vanishing toward the nearby park and the woods beyond.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Unless you are Sinners.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Eugene, with me. We're going after them.
Guided by the shackles, you track the fading traces of Mania. You soon realize: multiple intruders are on the move and they're all Sinners.
At one point, the trails abruptly scatter, forking into multiple divergent paths, only to merge again into one.
But five kilometers from the gallery, the trail vanishes entirely.

To release such concentrated Mania in such a short time—enough to trigger resonance with a rift—these individuals must be A-Class, if not S-Class. Yet for such a potent signature to vanish so completely... What exactly is going on here?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: For now, there's no sign of Mania overflow or a resonance rift forming.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content:
But this is no victory. All we did today was chase them off.
All this scattered wreckage... It's not a sign of their retreat. It's a warning. They will come back. And next time, they'll be more ruthless. More meticulous.
We can't afford to be careless.

After the chaos of the night, dawn breaks fully over the city. Around you, civilians begin to trickle onto the streets—curious, but cautious. They linger at café tables, pretending to read newspapers or sip drinks, all while stealing furtive glances in your direction.
Proceeding like this would only risk alerting the targets. With a wave of your hand, you dismiss the arrest squad, sending them home to rest except for Eugene.
After everyone leaves, you nod toward an elegant café nearby and offer to buy him a cup.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You've earned this coffee. The whole Bureau's been burning the midnight oil on this investigation. Sorry you've had to chase so many dead ends because of all that misinformation.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Don't mention it, Chief. And as for those vicious criminals terrorizing the city, we finally have hard evidence from the scene. They're not just some phantom thieves. They're Sinners.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: So it's all part of the job. Maybe once this is all wrapped up...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hm? Once it's wrapped up?
Eugene suddenly falls silent, his gaze shifting away. You instinctively follow his line of sight into the distance.
HEEEY! CHIIIIEF!!
